description: This file defines device configurations and build instructions for various MikroTik hardware devices used within an OpenWRT or similar build system. It includes device-specific parameters, image build steps, and device registration into the build target.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_nor
methods.description: Defines build parameters for MikroTik devices with NOR flash memory, including vendor, image size, kernel name, and image build pipeline.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Defines build parameters for MikroTik devices with NAND flash memory, including vendor, kernel details, and image pipeline.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_cap-ac
methods.description: Defines a device configuration that inherits from mikrotik_nor and specifies model, SOC, and device packages.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_hap-ac2
methods.description: Defines a device configuration inheriting from mikrotik_nor with specific model, SOC, and packages.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_hap-ac3
methods.description: Defines a NAND-based device configuration with specific model, SOC, block size, page size, and UBIFS options.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_hap-ac3-lte6-kit
methods.description: Defines a NOR-based device with LTE kit features, inheriting from mikrotik_nor.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_lhgg-60ad
methods.description: Defines a device configuration for the Wireless Wire Dish, including specific DTS and packages.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_sxtsq-5-ac
methods.description: Defines configuration for SXTsq 5 ac device, inheriting from mikrotik_nor.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_wap-ac
methods.description: Defines a wAP ac device inheriting from mikrotik_nor with additional packages.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_wap-r-ac
methods.description: Defines a variant of wAP R ac inheriting from mikrotik_wap-ac with USB and QMI support.

methods.name: Device/mikrotik_wap-ac-lte
methods.description: Defines a LTE-enabled variant of wAP ac, inheriting from mikrotik_wap-ac with alternative vendor/model and additional packages.
